text:
maya: Hey support — customer acme-inc started getting 500 on SSO after their IdP rotated certs. ACS URL unchanged.

devon: Error message?

maya: From our logs: "SAMLResponse validation failed: Signature of assertion doesn't match expected key" then a stack trace. No other errors.

maya: IdP metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml-metadata.xml

anita: We rotated signing keys with a double-key rollout. Metadata now lists two <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries. Could be ordering-related.

carlos: Some SP libraries just use the first signing KeyDescriptor they see. If the assertion is signed by the previous key but metadata lists the new key first, validation fails.

devon: Can you paste the relevant part of the metadata (just the KeyDescriptor order)?

maya: Sure — snippet from their metadata:

```xml
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>NEW_CERT_BASE64==</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>OLD_CERT_BASE64==</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
```

devon: That matches the symptom. Repro steps (quick):
1) Fetch metadata (the order matters)
2) Send SAMLResponse signed with OLD cert to /auth/saml/acs
3) SP tries NEW cert first -> signature mismatch -> 500.

olivia: Temporary workarounds:
- IdP: republish metadata with OLD key listed first, or set old key use="signing"/priority tags depending on metadata generator.
- SP: accept any matching signing key in metadata; many libs have a fallback option.
- Admin: upload the expected cert directly in SP dashboard (manual override).

maya: Customer says their assertions are still signed with the old key during rollout. They don't want to revert rotation globally. Need a short-lived fix.

anita: We can quickly republish metadata with ordering swapped (old first) and set metadata TTL to a low value so SP picks up change fast. I'll push that now.

devon: Also clear our cached metadata for that SP. Run: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/admin/metadata/refresh?sp=acme-inc" 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```

maya: Doing the curl now.

deploy-bot: metadata refresh queued for acme-inc (job 98765) :gear:

support-bot: webhook: idp-metadata-published acme-inc by anita

maya: Update from customer — they tried login, got through. SAML assertion validated. :tada:

carlos: Follow-up for engineering: make signature key lookup tolerant (try all KeyDescriptors for use="signing") and add a metadata priority hint. Filed ticket INF-8421.

anita: Also note: if you rotate two keys, consider marking the soon-to-expire one as use="encryption" until it's fully retired to avoid this.

maya: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop with customer now. :white_check_mark:
